data_point: Revenue is billed labour rather than a product
run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company's revenue is billed labour (coaching, training, local services) rather than a product.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies. Skip this if the company is a local professional services firm, which is already scored by its own signal.
yes_when: Pricing by the hour, session or project for work done by people
no_when: The company sells a product or software
watch_out_for: Software with optional onboarding services is a product company

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
